_comment: Distribution limits use the worst observed value ± 3 sample SDs, rounded outward, from `npm run calibrate:phonemes` (30 non-overlapping RNG streams, sampleSize words, lexicon, morphology off). This is an engineering margin, not a false-failure probability guarantee. Inventory coverage is fixed at 0: calibration fails on any generated-only mass, missing CMU phonemes, or rejected tokens. Recalibration measures a change; justify any loosened limit with its linguistic benefit and leave unaffected limits unchanged. Shared Pearson r is reported but not gated (2026-11 recalibration). See TUNING.md. 2026-11-13: minRepresentation and maxAbsoluteGapPct loosened after forbidOpenCheckedFinal removed open-final /ɪ ɛ æ ʌ ʊ/ (issue #398); /ɪ/ under-rep and abs gap moved while TV/over-rep stayed within prior limits (5-seed recalibration).
